title: Add Funded By Zukunft Bau Footer Button
description: Add a "Funded by Zukunft Bau" button with the Zukunft Bau logo to the shared app shell footer (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx Footer items), positioned between the middle (centered) region and the right corner. It must link to https://www.zukunftbau.de/projekte/forschungsfoerderung/1008187-2506. Add a small inline SVG ZukunftBauLogo component to ui/js/react/index.tsx near the existing SemioLogo, following the same pattern (self-contained functional component accepting className/style). Wire it into the Footer's items array as a right-aligned (ms-auto) normal item rendering an anchor tag with the logo and label, opening in a new tab.
summary: Corrected the dark Zukunft Bau Forschungsförderung logo at ui/asset/logo/zukunft-bau-dark.png. Rebuilt the transparent 669×126 asset from a matching high-resolution source instead of recoloring the previously matted PNG, mapped the original black foreground to Semio dark-appearance foreground #F7F3E3, preserved Zukunft Bau yellow, and post-normalized every visible pixel onto the foreground↔yellow two-color blend. Pixel QA reports zero pixels closer to the original black; visual QA on #001117 confirms no black remnants or matte halos. The @semio-tech/ui-react quick and long Nx test targets emitted no assertion failure but were killed by their configured 30 s and 300 s budgets respectively. All downloaded sources and comparison/preview artifacts remain in the ticket folder.
